rows.note: This is the all-purpose spoken choice for describing something's original state or situation.

example.jyutping: ngo5 bun2 loi4 zyu6 hai2 gau2 lung4

rows.note: Use this when “originally” means at the beginning of a process or event, rather than describing an earlier state.

example.jyutping: jat1 hoi1 ci2 ngo5 dei6 dou1 hou2 gan2 zoeng1
